# Frontend vendor source

The following files are vendored from Three.js 0.180.0 so the local simulator does
not depend on a CDN at runtime:

- `three.module.min.js`
- `three.core.min.js`
- `STLLoader.js`
- `OrbitControls.js`

Source: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180>

Three.js is distributed under the MIT License. See the upstream repository for the
complete license text.
